title:
Comment of Bryce Hoppie in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15423-000
Submission Date: 11/2/2026

documents.name: 152179.txt
documents.text:
Bryce Hoppie, Eagle River, AK.
Dear Sir or Madame,
I write to you to express my opposition to allowing the Deepgreen Cook Inlet SPV project to move forward. From lacking any description of how silt-filled waters or variable but generally weak tidal currents will be accommodated as the power source, to likely impacts on marine mammals and fish stocks, to how the structures will withstand Peak Ground Accelerations from an active thrust fault system upon which is is intended to be built, the plan for the data center is so poorly constructed that it should be completely discredited and rejected. 
Bryce Hoppie, PhD
Eagle River, Alaska
